notes.title: Auto Launch & Quit alongside SteamVR
notes.content:
With this update, I added automatic launching and quitting capabilities that synchronize with SteamVR. Now, when you start your application, it will automatically launch SteamVR if it's not already running, ensuring a hassle-free VR setup.

But more importantly: I've also implemented a system that automatically detects when SteamVR is closed. As soon as SteamVR shuts down, MusicLayer will gracefully exit alongside it, saving your from the inconvenience of manually closing the overlay separately.

notes.title: Bugfixes for 23 May update
notes.content: The "Gesture Control Option for Enhanced User Experience" update introduced a new bug which now has been fixed.

notes.title: Gesture Control Option for Enhanced User Experience
notes.content: You can now toggle the "Gestures" setting to enabled or disabled, this can be useful in situations where you often accidentally activate the gestures. When you set the "Gestures" setting to off, you can only manage playback with the buttons present in the Steam Dashboard.

notes.title: Update notes for May 18
notes.content:
- Added option to hide the headphone when not in use. 

This feature was requested and I have implemented a new feature that allows you to hide the image of the headphone on your dominant hand. Now, you can take off your headphones and have your hands free for other tasks without the distraction of the visible image. Simply enable this option in the settings menu to enjoy a cleaner user interface.
